title: Canonical additive flat scalar realization
statement: For a small site J, a commutative ring A, a commutative ring sheaf R, and α:A_J→R, let F:Mod(A)→Mod(R) send M to the recorded sheafified extension of the recorded constant module sheaf [def-sfb-site-derived-constant-module-functor, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Its map is the sheafification of scalar extension on sections. This is an additive functor, with no flatness assumption.

proof.text: Define extension maps sectionwise by ModuleCat.extendScalars and sheafify. Identity and composition follow sectionwise and then by functoriality of sheafification.
Scalar extension is additive by its adjunction; module sheafification is additive by exactness. Compose with the recorded additive constant realization.
